Configuration

The Acme CLI reads its configuration from acme.config.json in the project root. Every field is optional; the defaults listed below are what the CLI uses when a field is absent from the file.

Where the configuration file is found

The CLI walks up from the current working directory until it finds a configuration file, stopping at the first repository boundary it encounters. Passing --config skips the search entirely and loads exactly the file you name.

{
  "output": "dist",
  "concurrency": 4,
  "retries": 2
}

Supported fields

FieldDefaultDescription
outputdistDirectory build artifacts are written to.
concurrency4How many pages are fetched in parallel.
retries2Retry attempts per failed request.

Environment overrides

Any field can be overridden by an environment variable named after it, uppercased and prefixed with ACME_. Environment variables always win over the configuration file. See the deployment guide for the variables a production deploy is expected to set.

  • ACME_OUTPUT overrides the output field.
  • ACME_CONCURRENCY overrides the concurrency field.
